g.text: Retained fraction of requested turn (colour clipped to 0–1; heading shown only for R ≥ 0.1)

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #000000; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: One stationary-cue experiment · All 240 retained activity vectors
Arrows show actual final P = M₁/M₁(initial), after 13,000 cue-free units. Pale rightward guides mark the initial vector P = 1.
Each panel: four cue-centre angles × five tested durations. Columns are duration categories; native clocks are not calibrated across models.
Weak R < 0.1: an unoriented circle has radius proportional to R; its measured value is printed. □ failed field-tail gate; △ unavailable full-field tail.
* Cue support intersects the initial half-contrast core: all 125 overlap cases are retained. Physical support stays 3 for chemical models and 0.2 for Spring.
Arrows and circles use one global magnitude scale and equal data-coordinate scales. This is an endpoint-vector view, with no success threshold or minimum-duration claim.
